matches.title: Monza vs Aris Thessaloniki
matches.description: Watch Monza vs Aris Thessaloniki highlights and goals from Friendly on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on July 30, 2026. Monza and Aris Thessaloniki locked horns in a pre-season friendly aimed at sharpening tactical discipline and match fitness. Both managers used the opportunity to experiment with their lineups in a fixture that promised plenty of competitive energy. Aris Take Control On July 30, 2026 , the match unfolded with Aris Thessaloniki looking the sharper of the two sides. The Greek visitors established a commanding rhythm early on, utilizing efficient wing play and a solid midfield anchor to dictate the tempo. Monza struggled to find their passing range under pressure, often finding themselves pinned back in their own half as the visitors searched for openings in the defensive line. The visitors' dominance was eventually reflected clearly on the scoreboard as the match entered its final stages. In the 85th minute, Aris Thessaloniki struck again to extend their lead to 0-3 , effectively putting the result beyond doubt. Their clinical execution in front of goal left the home side searching for answers as the clock ticked down toward the final whistle. A Late Consolation for the Hosts Refusing to end the game without a fight, Monza pushed forward in the dying moments of stoppage time. Their persistence paid off in the 93rd minute when Andrea Colpani found space in the box to fire home a well-deserved goal. While the strike made the score 1-3 , it proved to be the final meaningful action of the game. Aris Thessaloniki secured a morale-boosting victory, while Monza left the pitch with valuable lessons ahead of their upcoming campaign.
